purpose: Identify a larger serving mechanism after the fixed V24 router screen; avoid a blind native-kernel transplant.

findings.native: epi_A and repeated A epilogues apply SwiGLU to FP32 GEMM accumulators before casting the activation BF16. B epilogues multiply FP32 GEMM accumulators by post-norm weight and store FP32 ybuf before the finalizer.
findings.serving: Stock Marlin writes gate/up GEMM results to hidden-state-dtype cache1 before silu_and_mul, and down GEMM output to hidden-state-dtype cache3 before post-expert norm. Selected BF16 serving therefore requires the intermediate BF16 roundings.
findings.action: A fused serving implementation must round scaled gate/up and down values at those exact boundaries. This cannot be solved by casting only final output.

findings.native: Forms 1 + given BF16 post_norm_w in FP32 in B epilogues.
findings.action: Consume the already effective BF16 norm weight; do not reconstruct 1+w in higher precision.

findings.issue: Persistent weight copies cannot be copied wholesale
findings.native: Each _prepare_layout retains natural, fat, unit and WGS code+scale layouts; prepare calls it twice for tiny and larger bit layouts.
findings.action: Design one serving packing strategy and establish every retained allocation and applicable path before any full-model port.

findings.native: _prepare_layout fixes lo=0,cnt=32; state owns reusable scratch shared by kernel_fn calls.
findings.action: Use actual per-rank expert IDs and separate supported execution scratch ownership; verify stream/capture lifecycle before concurrent serving.

weight_memory_arithmetic.assumptions: 32 local experts; each has gate/up/down 4096x4096; 4-bit codes and one FP8 scale per16 values; four retained code+scale copies per prepared layout, two layouts. Excludes gs/norm/LUT, scratch, input/original weights, repack temporaries and every other model component.
weight_memory_arithmetic.scope: 62 is the source configuration default, not an inspected loaded checkpoint; total shown only as an illustrative scenario.

next_falsifiable_step: After V24 closes, choose a single serving-compatible weight layout and produce a source/byte-count plan preserving BF16 endpoints. Kill a direct transplant immediately if it retains the eight native copies or omits required BF16 roundings. No performance upper bound is defensible until matched BF16-boundary component evidence exists.

critic.verdict: Direct transplant blocked by precision boundaries, effective norm weight, memory and runtime ownership; scout arithmetic and source correspondence confirmed.
critic.memory_check: With WGS enabled, natural+fat+unit+WGS are each full code+scale copies in both layouts. 905969664 bytes/copy,6.75GiB/layer;418.5GiB only62-sparse-layer source-default scenario.
